name: radio-group
useFor: Use for one choice among two to five options that should stay visible (a checkout mode, a shipping speed). Label every option with a Label (variant control) beside its circle, and give the group a name for FormData. For more options use Select; for a compact row of choices use Toggle Group.
constraints: A radio for a yes or no setting (use Switch)
A filled blue circle with no white ring
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the checkbox and the blue key)
title: Radio Group
description: 18px white circles on the hairline; the chosen one takes the blue edge and a blue dot.
